injuries.note: ir

injuries.name: Devon Levi
injuries.note: Levi landed on injured reserve Friday after reportedly sustaining an injury during Thursday's 6-5 loss to the Hurricanes. Prior to going down, the 24-year-old netminder posted a 6-1-0 record, a 3.11 GAA and an .887 save percentage across seven appearances. In his absence, Tristan Jarry is poised to serve as the lead netminder. Given Levi's current injury timetable, he is expected to rejoin the Oilers' lineup roughly in mid-November.

injuries.name: Alec Regula
injuries.note: Regula continues to work his way back from offseason surgery that caused him to miss the entire preseason. With the shift to LTIR, the 26-year-old defenseman can be expected to miss at least the next nine games, having already been out of action for one, though it could be longer, considering the team hasn't provided a specific update.

injuries.name: Matt Savoie
injuries.note: By moving Savoie to LTIR, the Oilers will get some cap relief while he is sidelined, as their injuries have started to pile up. The 22-year-old forward logged all 82 regular-season games in his rookie campaign, generating 18 goals and 19 assists, including seven power-play points. Considering Savoie is expected to miss at least the first two weeks of the season, fantasy managers probably shouldn't be expecting him to significantly outperform those numbers in 2026-27.

injuries.name: Frederik Andersen
injuries.note: Andersen, who signed a one-year, $1 million contract with Edmonton in July, is still rehabbing from a knee injury. He posted a 16-14-5 record with a 3.05 GAA and an .874 save percentage in 35 appearances for Carolina during the 2025-26 regular season. Once he's ready to play in the 2026-27 campaign with the Oilers, Andersen could compete for starts with Tristan Jarry and Devon Levi.

injuries.name: Mattias Janmark
injuries.note: Janmark underwent an undisclosed procedure earlier in the year, but he's currently shelved until further notice. The 33-year-old winger was limited in 2025-26, where he compiled a goal and eight points across 43 regular-season outings. In his absence, Mathieu Joseph and Max Jones are expected to serve as the team's left wingers in the bottom six to open the 2026-27 campaign.

injuries.name: Atro Leppanen
injuries.note: ir-nr

injuries.name: Eeli Tolvanen
injuries.note: Tolvanen also missed last Friday's practice while tending to a personal matter, but his previous absence from practice didn't force him to miss any games. It's not yet clear whether Friday's lack of participation will impact his status for Sunday's game against the Oilers, but a better idea of his availability could come into focus based on whether he's on the ice for the Rangers' morning skate ahead of the game.

injuries.name: James Reimer
injuries.note: After seemingly getting the hook due to early struggles in his Rangers debut Monday, it appears that Reimer sustained an injury in the contest, which likely played a part in the team's decision to pull him after the first period. He made five saves on eight attempts Monday, but wasn't credited with the loss due to the Kings' offense going off in a 6-3 win. Reimer is the third goalie for the Rangers to suffer an injury this season. However, the team doesn't play again until Sunday, meaning that he might not miss any time. If he can't go in New York's next clash, Spencer Martin will likely be called up to serve as the backup.

injuries.name: Igor Shesterkin
injuries.note: Shesterkin was hurt during Friday's game against the Capitals when his right leg got jammed into the post while returning to the crease on a scrambled play, and the Rangers ruled him out for the season a day later. He was placed on injured reserve Sunday, and the team has now provided some clarification on the exact nature of his injury. Dylan Garand is slated to serve as the Rangers' No. 1 option in the crease until Joonas Korpisalo (lower body) is back in action.

injuries.name: Joe Veleno
injuries.note: Veleno has already missed the last two games, and he is slated to miss at least three more months. He hasn't earned a point in four appearances this season, but he has contributed two shots on goal, five blocked shots and seven hits.

injuries.name: Joonas Korpisalo
injuries.note: Korpisalo has already missed the first six games of the season and remains on injured reserve. The Rangers announced Saturday that Igor Shesterkin (lower body) will miss the remainder of the 2026-27 campaign. With Korpisalo and Shesterkin unavailable, Dylan Garand is currently the Rangers' No. 1 goaltender.
